You make out an opened fridge. Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this? You see a closed oven. You see a table. The table is massive. On the table you can see a cookbook. Hmmm... what else, what else? You make out a counter. You see a raw purple potato on the counter. You bend down to tie your shoe. When you stand up, you notice a stove. The stove is conventional. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it.

There is an open sliding patio door leading east. There is a closed plain door leading north. You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is not blocked by one.

There is a block of cheese and a carrot on the floor.
